Who We Are

Built at the intersection of silicon & intelligence

FosterIve Systems was founded on the belief that India's deep tech moment has arrived — and it needs partners who can deliver end-to-end, without gaps, without handoffs.

We combine semiconductor engineering depth with expertise in AI, data science and embedded systems — serving startups, enterprises and innovators who are building what comes next.

Based in Bengaluru, at the heart of India's technology ecosystem.
